name: Asuka Mirai
source:
Mirai is the girl that the protagonist saved from the thugs in the beginning of the story and her family own a large company in Japan so she's really rich. She is completely rabu rabu over the protagonist for the whole story which is really quite adorable. Mirai also has a little sister who attends the same school as her. Also, she's very good with a sword.

[From [url=http://liemyx.livejournal.com/1263.html]Liemyx's review[/url].]
